bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/bug-report-20261115"
UW="$ROOT/.worktrees/userbot-report-20261115"
test -d "$WT" && test -d "$UW" || exit 30
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = c2f6478e2b1f8cd04fd8a9f8d4bff7d6000b705e || exit 31
test -z "$(git -C "$UW" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 32
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/userbot-report-recipient-20261115 >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 88083d6ebf2bf0731fbe50bd79463e36c911f403 || exit 33
git -C "$UW" checkout --detach 88083d6ebf2bf0731fbe50bd79463e36c911f403 >/dev/null
cd "$UW"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -B scripts/test_userbot_resident_ipc.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 42
cd "$ROOT"
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if ! docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|frozen-lockfile|TS[0-9]{4}' "$LOG"; then exit 51; fi
 if grep -Eq 'no space left|ENOSPC' "$LOG"; then exit 52; fi
 exit 55
fi
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bug-report-c2f6478 -c 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "🐞 不具合を報告" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || exit 56
printf 'USERBOT_IPC_TEST=PASS\nGAYBBS_IMAGE_BUILD=PASS\n'
